key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks (Headlines 49, 73)
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations (Headline 55)
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare, amplifying import costs and fuel price pressures (Headlines 59, 47)
Oil prices surged on Gulf tensions; supertanker rates hit $800k/day, boosting energy sector (Headlines 60, 41)
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate-cut timeline (Headline 71)
ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 job cuts faces execution risk (Headline 24)
Housing market correction deepens: no auction spring bounce, first-home buyer surge, Leith Van Onselen warns of further falls (Headlines 23, 62, 81)
US CPI acceleration pushes Fed toward rate hike, pressuring global risk assets (Headline 35)
Treasury $6bn bond buyback failed to lower mortgage rates, signalling limited policy efficacy (Headline 34)
Small-cap mining active: PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources; Canaccord-led cap raises (Headlines 44, 50)

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners leading the $90bn weekly selloff. Small-cap explorers (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength on discovery news.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from falling iron ore. Gold miners (Gateway WA, Kuniko) benefit from inflation hedge demand. Canaccord-led cap raises signal capital-raising overhang for juniors.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate fears pressure bank valuations. ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 cuts adds execution risk. Treasury bond buyback failure undermines confidence in policy support.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM compression risk if RBA holds rates. Rising yields could support net interest margins short-term but cap equity multiples.

sectors.trend: Positive. Oil surge on Gulf tensions; supertanker rates at $800k/day. Australia softening gas supply rules eases Asian energy fears. Santos preservation noted as strategic priority.
sectors.implications: Woods Point, Oil Search, and Santos (if listed) benefit. Higher fuel costs (30c rise) pressure transport and consumer sectors. LNG exporters gain from firm gas prices.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-negative. Woolworths (WES.AX) breached its own 'Price Freeze' on four staples, eroding consumer trust. Falling house prices boost first-home buyers but broader consumer confidence weak.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CPL.AX face margin pressure from input costs. Housing correction may boost retail footfall but income effect is negative.

sectors.trend: Neutral. CSL.AX relatively insulated from commodity/rate shocks. Small-cap tech (Neurizon, Iondrive) showing momentum. US tech (Nvidia DOJ scrutiny, Qualcomm revenue concerns) creates global risk-off spillover.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive exposure. ASX small-cap tech (Neurizon, Iondrive) benefits from rotation but faces liquidity risk in risk-off.

sectors.trend: Negative. Housing correction deepens with no auction bounce. Leith Van Onselen warns of further price falls. Rental inflation keeps RBA cautious, supporting REIT occupancy but pressuring valuations via higher discount rates.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face yield compression risk. Property developers under pressure. Migrant-driven construction demand (Headline 80) is a partial offset.

key_themes: Global rate-hike fears (US CPI acceleration) driving risk-off across ASX
Iron ore structural weakness pressuring ASX 20 heavyweights
AUD weakness amplifying import inflation and fuel cost pressures
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth slowdown
Housing market correction transitioning from price drops to volume recovery
Energy sector outperforming on geopolitical oil supply risk
Superannuation reform debate creating policy uncertainty
Small-cap mining discovery cycle providing relative outperformance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global rate-hike contagion from US CPI acceleration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour short-duration and floating-rate instruments. Hedge AUD via energy and gold exposure.
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and critical minerals (Critical Resources, Gateway WA).
Favour domestic-revenue companies (WES.AX, CSL.AX); avoid import-heavy retailers. Monitor RBA intervention signals.
Reduce REIT and construction exposure; monitor first-home buyer data for stabilisation signal.
Maintain energy sector allocation as hedge; monitor supertanker rate normalisation.
Monitor political signals; super fund equities (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) may face regulatory overhang.

opportunities.rationale: Oil surge on Gulf tensions and $800k/day tanker rates create cyclical upside; Australia's gas supply rule easing supports LNG exporters

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold and critical minerals
opportunities.rationale: Inflation hedge demand (US CPI acceleration) supports gold; discovery pipeline (Gateway WA, Kuniko, Critical Resources) offers asymmetric upside

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap mining exposure on discovery catalysts
opportunities.rationale: PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources showing momentum; Canaccord cap raises indicate institutional interest
CSL.AX insulated from commodity/rate shocks; global demand resilient; NDIS policy debate supports sector narrative

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and heavy materials exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; structural demand concerns from China; ASX 20 miners leading selloff

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim REIT and property developer positions
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing correction has further to run per Leith Van Onselen; no auction bounce; rental inflation constrains RBA easing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness via energy and gold
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; import inflation (fuel +30c) pressures consumer margins; AUD recovery uncertain
Post-3,500 job cuts, cost savings must translate to EPS; execution risk elevated

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as rate-hike fears persist and iron ore weakness continues. Oil-driven energy outperformance will be offset by broad risk-off. AUD weakness adds import inflation pressure. RBA on hold, watching rental inflation. Expect volatility around US CPI data and RBA commentary.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction nearing completion (first-home buyer surge). Energy transition and critical minerals offer structural growth. Superannuation system, while under political pressure, remains a long-term wealth engine. Key inflection: iron ore stabilisation and RBA pivot to cuts.
